scenarios.name: Standard Sandbox
scenarios.description: The baseline HELM simulation with deliberate progression and balanced pacing across the shared control-room runtime.
onboardingChecklist: Run the sim only after you can read the queue and the right-rail alarms.
Use Always approve on routine yellow and orange work to keep the queue under control.
Escalate medical, regulatory, and treasury edge cases instead of chasing raw speed.

scenarios.name: Public Demo Showcase
scenarios.description: A staged nine-pack showcase tuned for a 12 to 18 minute public demo, with fast funding milestones and clearer control-room feedback.
onboardingChecklist: Start paused, read the queue, and pick the card with the highest blast radius first.
Use Run, Pause, and 2x or 4x speed to control intake instead of letting backlog dictate the session.
Turn routine yellow or orange cards into policies so the demo can scale across all nine packs.
Watch milestone grants in Capital and unlock the next pack as soon as trust and cash allow it.
